name: Equivariance Reference Fixture
regime: schematic two-parameter actions with a one-parameter map, closed under the seven Phase-1 rules

premises.statement: Two-parameter schematic actions rho_X(g,v) = g*v and rho_Y(g,v) = g*v as Function artifacts.
One-parameter schematic map f(v) = 2*v as a Function artifact.
Pre-constructed staged outer Calls LHS_1 = f(g*x) and RHS_1 = rho_Y(g, 2*x) with byte-linkage to derivation outputs, because EXPR-APPLY-001 is root-Call-only.

expected_result.description: Both derivation sides close to 2*g*x with identical canonical bytes; the theorem relation embeds those bytes.

limitations.description: g and x are schematic ParameterID-bound symbols, not a general quantified-variable system.
Concrete functions f(v)=2v and rho(g,v)=g*v chosen to close under the seven rules without distributivity.
No Group, GroupAction, or Domain sort exists; G/X/Y are fixture labels.
rho_X and rho_Y are canonically identical artifacts; distinction lives in interpretation.
Cross-framework disagreement is demonstrated by the separate fixture2 conformance package.
Representation and replay only; no numerical execution.

falsification_conditions.description: Derivation fails if Step 2 and Step 5 canonical bytes differ.
Fixture construction fails if a staged Call argument does not match its source step output.
Theorem construction fails if the relation does not embed the designated final bytes.
